sources.dem: AWS Terrain Tiles (Terrarium) z10 south of 60N / z9 north of 60N
sources.highways: Statistics Canada Road Network File 2023, classes 10-13
sources.rail: NRCan National Railway Network (NRWN), operational track excl. yards
sources.places: NRCan Canadian Geographical Names - populated places + Indian reserves
